name: token-rate
description: Real-time token rate & usage stats for ZCode sessions (MCP tool + /token-rate command + per-turn hook line); output language auto-follows the environment (zh/en), style/window/language configurable in plugin settings. ZCode 会话 token 速率与用量实时统计，输出语言自动跟随（中/英），样式/窗口/语言可在插件设置中配置。

inject_line.title: 每轮注入速率行 / Inject per-turn rate line
inject_line.description: 关闭后 hook 不再向会话注入 [token-rate] 行（MCP 工具与 /token-rate 命令不受影响）。/ When off, the hook stops injecting the [token-rate] line (MCP tool and /token-rate command are unaffected).

line_style.title: 速率行样式 / Rate line style
line_style.description: compact = 极简一行（默认）；detailed = 完整统计。/ compact = minimal one-liner (default); detailed = full stats.

window_minutes.title: 吞吐窗口（分钟）/ Throughput window (minutes)
window_minutes.description: 吞吐统计的滑动窗口大小，默认 10。/ Sliding window size for throughput stats, default 10.

language.title: 输出语言 / Output language
language.description: zh / en / auto（跟随环境，默认）。/ zh / en / auto (follow the environment, default).
